follow-up time: 8 weeks after birth and before 38 weeks' postconceptual age
exposure: Preterm infants with retinopathy of prematurity (ROP)
cohort: The study included 299 preterm infants without ROP and 107 preterm infants with ROP.
finding: Serum EPO level on the 28th day after birth and gestational age were independent predictors of ROP.
